knowledgeAnswers.rationale: On alarm the lesson says to stop work, leave by the safe route, follow trained wardens and not return for belongings.
The lesson says not to return until authorised, and to resume only after the responsible person confirms the site is safe.
The record is factual, avoids speculation about causes and protects personal information.

practicalCriteria: Learner identifies the exits, alarm call points, extinguisher locations, assembly point and emergency contact on arrival at a supplied site.
Learner responds to a simulated alarm by stopping at a safe point, leaving by the nearest safe exit and not using the lift.
Learner, at a simulated assembly point, reports who they were working with and records the event and the people accounted for.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of the site emergency arrangements noted on arrival
Incident record for any alarm, evacuation or emergency, with people accounted for
stopWorkCriteria: Learner re-enters a building before it is cleared
Learner uses a lift during an evacuation
Learner attempts to search for a gas source before leaving
